title_en: Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Trial of Civil Cases involving Notarization Activities

articles.content_en: Article 1 Where a party or an interested person of a notarized matter institutes prosecution with a People's Court for civil compensation in accordance with Article 43 of the Notarization Law, the notarization institution shall be named as the defendant, and the People's Court shall accept the case as a tort liability dispute.

Article 2 Where a party or an interested person of a notarized matter institutes prosecution requesting modification or revocation of a notarization certificate or confirmation of invalidity of a notarization certificate, the People's Court shall not accept the case and shall inform such party or interested person that, in accordance with Article 39 of the Notarization Law, they may apply to the notarization institution that issued the notarization certificate for re-examination.

Article 3 Where a party or an interested person of a notarized matter has a dispute over the civil rights and obligations notarized in a notarization certificate, they may, in accordance with Article 40 of the Notarization Law, institute a civil action with the People's Court over the dispute.
Where a party or an interested person of a notarized matter directly institutes a civil action with the People's Court over a dispute concerning the civil rights and obligations of a notarized debt instrument with compulsory execution effect, the People's Court shall not accept the case according to law. However, except where the notarized debt instrument has been ruled by the People's Court not to be enforced.

Article 5 Where a party provides false supporting materials to apply for notarization, causing the notarization certificate to be erroneous and losses to others, the party shall bear compensation liability. Where the notarization institution has fulfilled its examination and verification obligations according to law, it shall not bear compensation liability; where it has failed to fulfill its examination and verification obligations according to law, it shall bear supplementary compensation liability corresponding to its fault; where it knowingly knows that the materials certified by notarization are false or maliciously colludes with the party, it shall bear joint and several compensation liability.

Article 6 Where a party or an interested person of a notarized matter knowingly uses a notarization certificate issued by the notarization institution which is untrue or unlawful, causing losses to himself or herself, and requests the notarization institution to bear compensation liability, the People's Court shall not support the request.

Article 7 After these Provisions come into force, where civil cases involving notarization activities have not yet been finally adjudicated, these Provisions shall apply; where such cases have been finally adjudicated before these Provisions come into force, and a party applies for retrial or a retrial is decided in accordance with the trial supervision procedure, these Provisions shall not apply.
